paper.title: RNA neoantigen vaccines prime long-lived CD8+ T cells in pancreatic cancer
paper.trialContext: Phase 1: surgery, atezolizumab (anti–PD-L1), autogene cevumeran, mFOLFIRINOX; extended ~3.2-year median follow-up
paper.source_note: Aggregates from Nature supplemental source tables (MOESM5–15). De-identified published patient IDs. Not Personalised Cancer Care clinical data.
paper.methodsNote: Unlike the melanoma NeoVaxMI reanalysis (leave-one-out clone expansion and mutation-landscape tallies), this PDAC pass emphasises longevity kinetics: bootstrap CIs, Wilcoxon signed-rank on paired prime/boost half-lives, and Spearman correlation between peak clonal frequency and predicted lifespan.

B: Wilcoxon signed-rank prime vs boost half-life
